critical_code_review_comments: routes_main.py is 856 lines — approaching the 700-line soft limit. Consider splitting into auth.py, candidate.py, jobs.py, applications.py, coach.py, notifications.py, plans.py modules for maintainability.

All critical patterns look good: Mongo _id excluded via projections, async/await used throughout, env vars read from os.environ, pydantic models validate every endpoint, bearer token auth via sessions, rate limiting applied on write endpoints, magic-byte file validation present, RBAC enforced via require_roles dependency.
